about_the_game:
Streep is a puzzle-adventure game where you play as a pen breaking free from a life of dull routine under the control of Noir™, a company that hoards all color for itself.

Solve puzzles using color, experiment with a range of color-based mechanics, and bring vibrancy back to a lifeless world. Each stroke challenges the system. Each color you restore is a step toward freedom.

It’s time to rebel!

Take Back the Color

Once, the world was alive. Bursting with color, warmth, and wonder. But then Noir™ came.

They said it was for our safety. That too much color was dangerous. So they bottled it up, locked it away, and drained the world until only grey remained. Now, Noir™ controls every last hue, and the world has forgotten what it means to feel alive.

But not you.

You Are the Pen

You don’t wield the Pen.
You are the Pen.

With every line, you fight back against Noir™ grip on the colors. You glide through the world, Finding friends, fighting foes, and coloring the streets. You make the world a happier place. You bring joy where only silence remains.

Ink is your lifeblood. Imagination is your weapon.
And the world? It’s your canvas.

You were just another pen....

Another cog in the endless Noir™ machine, spending your days drawing bottles.
No questions asked. No strokes outside the lines. Just work.
Endless, grey, work.

Day after day, you watched the color drain from the world and helped bottle what little remained. But something changed. Maybe it was the silence. Maybe it was the memory of a brighter line you once drew.
Or maybe… it was just that one dream. that dream about colors...

Disclaimer: Please note that everything you see on this page is subject to change. We are still in the process of experimenting and fine-tuning the best experience for our game. Thank you for your understanding and support as we work to create the best possible version of our game!

short_description: In Streep, you play as a pen. Once a worker for Noir, the color-hoarding corporation, you've broken free from the grey. Restoring color and fighting against the forces that want to keep the world dull and controlled. Bring life back to a fading world, one stroke at a time.
